title: Overcoming strength-ductility tradeoff with high pressure thermal treatment

recollection.mechanism: guess: grain refinement and precipitation hardening

score.note: The intervention merely repeats the title and omits the specific HPHT hexahedron-anvil treatment. The recalled grain refinement and precipitation-hardening account is incorrect; the actual mediator was a hierarchical FCC/B2 microstructure with coherent interfaces enabling dislocation transfer and multiple deformation modes. Results are only described generically, with no recollection of the 1150 MPa fracture strength, 36% uniform elongation, or nearly 100% enhancement.
